title: ReasoningBank: Scaling Agent Self-Evolving with Reasoning Memory
authors_zh: Siru Ouyang、Jun Yan、I-Hung Hsu、Yanfei Chen、Ke Jiang、Zifeng Wang、Rujun Han、Long T. Le、Samira Daruki、Xiangru Tang、Vishy Tirumalashetty、George Lee、Mahsan Rofouei、Hangfei Lin、Jiawei Han、Chen-Yu Lee、Tomas Pfister（机构以官方论文为准）
best_for_zh: 研究推理预算分配与测试时扩展的读者。
one_line: ReasoningBank: Scaling Agent Self-Evolving with Reasoning Memory
持续运行的代理会反复丢弃成功和失败交互中的洞见，因此更多测试时探索可能重复同样错误，而不是积累有用经验。
why: It makes an inference-budget decision auditable.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly changes or measures how a reasoning system spends test-time computation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Persistent agents repeatedly discard insights from successful and failed interactions, so more test-time exploration can reproduce the same errors instead of accumulating useful experience.

The paper asks how additional inference work can change the model’s decision rather than merely lengthen a trace. The useful comparison must account for the resource consumed by every candidate, revision, optimization step, or auxiliary scorer.

持续运行的代理会反复丢弃成功和失败交互中的洞见，因此更多测试时探索可能重复同样错误，而不是积累有用经验。

本文研究额外推理工作如何改变模型决定，而不只是拉长轨迹。有效比较必须核算每个候选、修订、优化步骤或辅助评分器消耗的资源。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central proposal distills transferable strategies from self-judged trajectories into a retrievable memory and couples that memory with parallel or sequential memory-aware test-time scaling.

This treats test-time scaling as a controllable decision process. Extra computation is useful only when it changes exploration, selection, or policy refinement in a way that improves the final outcome under a stated budget.

核心方案把自我判断轨迹中的可迁移策略蒸馏为可检索记忆，并把该记忆与并行或顺序的记忆感知测试时扩展结合。

这把测试时扩展视为可控制的决策过程。只有当额外计算以在给定预算下改善最终结果的方式改变探索、选择或策略修订时，它才有用。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method distills transferable strategies from self-judged trajectories into a retrievable memory and couples that memory with parallel or sequential memory-aware test-time scaling.

A reproducible record retains the prompt, intermediate states or trajectories, every allocation decision, reward or confidence signal, final answer, and total generation and auxiliary cost. These fields allow a matched-budget comparison rather than a nominal token comparison.

该方法把自我判断轨迹中的可迁移策略蒸馏为可检索记忆，并把该记忆与并行或顺序的记忆感知测试时扩展结合。

可复现记录应保留提示、中间状态或轨迹、每个分配决定、奖励或置信度信号、最终答案，以及生成和辅助计算总成本。这些字段允许预算匹配的比较，而不是名义 token 比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports stronger effectiveness and efficiency than raw-trajectory or success-only memory on web browsing and software-engineering tasks, with further gains from MaTTS.

This evidence concerns the authors’ chosen models, tasks, and cost protocol. It supports the proposed mechanism, but it does not guarantee that a different model family, task distribution, or serving backend will follow the same quality–cost curve.

论文报告在网页浏览和软件工程任务上优于原始轨迹或仅成功记忆的有效性和效率，并从 MaTTS 获得进一步收益。

这些证据针对作者选择的模型、任务和成本协议。它支持所提机制，但不保证不同模型家族、任务分布或服务后端会遵循同样的质量—成本曲线。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Compared with a fixed reasoning recipe, the work makes a particular test-time control signal and allocation rule explicit.

Its contribution is not simply a stronger model or more samples. It specifies how the system should turn a finite inference allowance into policy improvement, candidate diversity, memory, or adaptive thinking.

与固定推理配方相比，该工作让一种特定的测试时控制信号和分配规则变得明确。

它的贡献不只是更强模型或更多样本，而是说明系统应如何把有限推理额度转化为策略改进、候选多样性、记忆或自适应思考。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The conclusion depends on the availability and calibration of its internal signal, the model architecture, decoding configuration, and task distribution. Auxiliary computation must be counted in deployment, and a method that looks efficient in estimated FLOPs may have different wall-clock behavior. Long or iterative reasoning can also compound errors, so reproduction should report both average and tail latency as well as failure traces.
结论依赖内部信号的可用性和校准、模型架构、解码配置和任务分布。部署时必须计入辅助计算，而在估计 FLOPs 中高效的方法可能具有不同的真实时钟表现。长或迭代推理还会累积错误，因此复现应报告平均和尾部时延以及失败轨迹。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when an application must decide how to allocate a finite inference budget rather than always use a fixed thinking length. Compare it against a matched-budget baseline, log the per-input decision and every auxiliary call, then measure correctness, pass@k where applicable, tokens, and end-to-end latency. It is most useful when the decision signal can be inspected or independently validated.
当应用必须决定如何分配有限推理预算，而不是总使用固定思考长度时，可以使用本文。应与预算匹配基线比较，记录逐输入决定和每次辅助调用，再测量正确性、适用时的 Pass@k、token 和端到端时延。当决策信号能够被检查或独立验证时，它最有用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper through the path from additional computation to a changed decision. Separate gains from more generation from gains from optimization, verification, memory retrieval, or adaptive allocation. The strongest audit plots quality against realized compute and includes cases in which the controller spends more yet makes the answer worse; a single benchmark score cannot establish compute efficiency.
应通过从额外计算到改变决定的路径阅读本文。要把更多生成带来的收益与优化、验证、记忆检索或自适应分配带来的收益分开。最强审计把质量相对于实际计算作图，并包含控制器花得更多却让答案变差的案例；单个基准分数无法证明计算效率。
